I've completed my 12 searches. Here's a summary of the best wedding venue options in Paris (and the immediate Paris region) for 100 guests, ranked by the criteria of price, capacity, and reviews.

## Best Overall Options for 100 Guests

### 🏆 Best Value in Central Paris: **Hôtel Le Marois (France Amériques)**
- **Location:** 8th arrondissement, steps from Champs-Élysées (9-11 avenue Franklin D. Roosevelt)
- **Capacity:** Fits ~100 guests (8 modular lounges; ~850 m² of reception space)
- **Price:** Venue rental from **€5,500** + menu from **€190–240/person** — the most affordable option actually inside Paris
- **Reviews:** Highly rated (3 reviews on Bridebook, well-reviewed by planners); 19th-century private mansion with gilded Louix XV interiors

### 🏆 Best Balance of Price + Reviews (Paris proper): **Hotel Shangri-La Paris**
- **Location:** 16th arrondissement, Eiffel Tower views (former Bonaparte palace)
- **Capacity:** Recommended sweet spot is up to **100 guests** (venue hosts up to 500; sleeps 100)
- **Price:** Venue hire from **€7,200**; packages €305–415/person
- **Reviews:** **4.7★ (3,371 reviews)** — one of the most-reviewed, best-rated venues

### 🏆 Best Value Near Paris (Île-de-France): **Château Bouffémont**
- **Location:** Val-d'Oise, ~30 min from Paris
- **Capacity:** Up to 150 guests (comfortably fits 100)
- **Price:** **€8,500** all-inclusive (peak season, venue hire with overnight stay)
- **Reviews:** 4.5★ (263 reviews)

### ✅ Also In Paris (100-Guest Capacity Matches)
| Venue | Capacity | Price (from) | Reviews |
|-------|----------|--------------|---------|
| **Hôtel de Crillon** | 3 lounges = **100 guests** | Luxury (premium pricing) | 9.5/10 (96 reviews) |
| **Musée Rodin (Hôtel Biron)** | Up to **100** (cocktail) | €12,000 (venue) | Top-10 rated, 210 on Wezoree |
| **Peninsula Paris** | Up to 200 (ballroom for 100 dinner) | €18,750 | 4.7★ (3,858 reviews) |

### 🏰 Best Château-Style Options Near Paris (for 100 guests)
| Venue | Capacity | Price (from) | Reviews |
|-------|----------|--------------|---------|
| **Manoir de Vacheresses** | **110 guests** | €8,800 | 4.7★ (209) |
| **Château de Bonaventure** | 150 guests | €17,000 | **4.9★ (104)** |
| **Château de Villette** | up to 200 (100-guest package) | €28,750 | 4.6★ (173) |
| **Château de Vaux-le-Vicomte** | up to 170 (dance inside) | €50,000+ | 518 on Wezoree ($$$$) |

## My Recommendations
- **Lowest price with good quality:** **Hôtel Le Marois** (central Paris, ~€5,500 rental)
- **Best value + top reviews:** **Shangri-La Paris** (4.7★, from €7,200, ideal for 100 guests)
- **Best all-inclusive deal near Paris:** **Château Bouffémont** (€8,500)
- **Highest reviews overall:** **Château de Bonaventure** (4.9★, €17,000)

**Note:** For an exact 100-guest fit, Hôtel de Crillon (three salons = 100), Musée Rodin's Hôtel Biron (100 cocktail), and Shangri-La's recommended size (~100) are the strongest capacity matches *inside Paris*. If you're open to the immediate Paris region, Château Bouffémont and Manoir de Vacheresses offer the best price-to-review balance.
